observations: Only offline Cargo dependencies use link-aware version2 records.
Host, producer and offline consumer import the same schema and inventory.
Link targets preserve exact text, resolve to regular in-root registry/git files, and reject directory links, cycles, dangling links, escapes and special files.
Regular files are copied before links; source and destination complete inventories are checked after copy.
General evidence inventory remains unchanged and refuses symlinks.
Recorded tests cover real ENOTDIR for file/dot and legal relative dot components.
scope_limitations: This is custody of sealed inputs, not a proof against arbitrary concurrent hostile filesystem replacement.
